title: NCERT Non Academic Online Form 2026 for 173 Post
description: The National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) has announced recruitment for 173 Non-Academic posts. Online applications are open from December 27, 2025, to January 16, 2026. Candidates are advised to review the official notification on the NCERT website for detailed information regarding age limits, qualifications, vacancy details, syllabus, exam patterns, and admission procedures.

fillingProcedure: Candidates should apply online within the last date after carefully reading the official notification.
Ensure all required columns such as name, father's name, mother's name, date of birth, address, and qualification details are filled accurately.
Upload all necessary documents in the correct size and format (PDF or JPEG) as specified in the application form.
Before final submission, thoroughly re-check all entered information and uploaded documents.
After successful submission, take a printout or save a PDF copy of the application form for future reference.

title: BPSSC Bihar Police Havildar Clerk Online Form 2026
description: The Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has released a notification for the Havildar Clerk Recruitment 2026. Online applications are open from January 2, 2026, to February 2, 2026. Further details regarding age limit, qualifications, vacancy details, syllabus, exam pattern, and admission are available on the official website and Rojgar Result.
fillingProcedure: The Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released, and candidates must apply within the last date.
Candidates should carefully read the Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission Notification 2026 before applying for the recruitment application form.
While applying, candidates must fill all columns carefully to avoid mistakes in details such as name, father’s name, mother’s name, date of birth, address, and qualification details.
If document upload is required, ensure all documents are uploaded in the correct size and format (PDF or JPEG).
Before submitting the form, re-check all columns and uploaded documents for accuracy.
After submitting the Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission Recruitment 2026 form, take a printout or save it as a PDF for future reference.
